critical_code_review_comments: bulk_upload.py line 292: the branch `_normalize_row(row) if any(isinstance(v, str) for v in row.values()) else row` is fragile. If a client sends already-normalized rows (all non-string after parse), the second validate uses the raw row without defaulting image_filenames — works today because the parse endpoint returns strings mixed with parsed values, but a purely machine-generated commit payload could surprise. Consider always running _normalize_row with idempotent coercions.

bulk_upload.py /images: the loop always issues an update_one even when no filenames resolve, which clears pending_image_filenames prematurely. Minor — UX is fine because the wizard doesn't re-attempt after skip.
BulkUploadModal.jsx header still says '4-step wizard' in the JSDoc but there are actually 5 steps (Template, Input, Preview, Images, Done).
No critical issues found; endpoints + wizard are cleanly implemented.
